text: {"type_map":{},"constraints":[{"id":"R1","category":"count_semantics","alternatives":["(df['ct_srv_src'] <= df['ct_src_ltm'])"],"features":["ct_srv_src","ct_src_ltm"],"rationale":"Connections matching both the service and source address are a subset of connections matching the source address."},{"id":"R2","category":"count_semantics","alternatives":["(df['ct_srv_dst'] <= df['ct_dst_ltm'])"],"features":["ct_srv_dst","ct_dst_ltm"],"rationale":"Connections matching both the service and destination address are a subset of connections matching the destination address."},{"id":"R3","category":"count_semantics","alternatives":["(df['ct_src_dport_ltm'] <= df['ct_src_ltm'])"],"features":["ct_src_dport_ltm","ct_src_ltm"],"rationale":"Connections matching both the source address and destination port are a subset of connections matching the source address."},{"id":"R4","category":"count_semantics","alternatives":["(df['ct_dst_sport_ltm'] <= df['ct_dst_ltm'])"],"features":["ct_dst_sport_ltm","ct_dst_ltm"],"rationale":"Connections matching both the destination address and source port are a subset of connections matching the destination address."},{"id":"R5","category":"count_semantics","alternatives":["(df['ct_dst_src_ltm'] <= df['ct_src_ltm'])"],"features":["ct_dst_src_ltm","ct_src_ltm"],"rationale":"Connections matching both source and destination addresses are a subset of connections matching the source address."},{"id":"R6","category":"count_semantics","alternatives":["(df['ct_dst_src_ltm'] <= df['ct_dst_ltm'])"],"features":["ct_dst_src_ltm","ct_dst_ltm"],"rationale":"Connections matching both source and destination addresses are a subset of connections matching the destination address."},{"id":"R7","category":"count_semantics","alternatives":["((df['is_ftp_login'] != 1) | (df['ct_ftp_cmd'] >= 1))"],"features":["is_ftp_login","ct_ftp_cmd"],"rationale":"An FTP session accessed using a username and password necessarily involves FTP commands."}]}
